adversarial.description: Not among contract 095's 14 listed verification commands. Mandatory adversarial spot-check per methodology/02_adversarial_tdd.md Sec 6-8, obeying the External Anchor Rule (Sec 7): the expected value is drawn from a source OUTSIDE the artifact under test. Chosen candidate (a): verbatim quote-fidelity of all seven checklist-layer epigraphs in templates/DoD.md against standard/definition_of_done.md Section 2's own layer table (the SOURCE One-Liner column), character-for-character -- not merely 'a Section N citation string appears somewhere in the block,' which contract verification item 7 already mechanizes structurally without ever diffing the quoted TEXT itself. This targets a gap the pipeline had not probed: a generator could satisfy item 7's heading-anchored citation-presence check while silently paraphrasing, truncating, or drifting the quoted sentence, and item 7 alone would not catch it. Deliberately NOT candidate (c) (extending the substitution test to all 14 non-carrier schemas), since that reprises the same substitution-test technique Mode B already applied to this file's dod_ref phrasing per the task framing, and NOT a repeat of the planted-eighth-block/first-occurrence-weakness hunt, since Mode B already probed that class of weakness for this file as shipped.
adversarial.result: PASS -- all 7 of 7 checklist-layer epigraphs (Step-Done, Handoff-Done, Gate-Done, Feature-Done, Plan-Done, Merge-Done, Release-Done) are byte-for-byte verbatim against standard/definition_of_done.md Section 2's layer table, both the quoted One-Liner text and the cited Section N (Sections 3-9 respectively). The task's own floor was a 3-row sample; all 7 rows were checked for completeness, and all 7 matched with zero deviation -- no paraphrase, truncation, punctuation drift, or off-by-one Section citation found in any row. Independently re-extracted both sides programmatically (the source table parsed from standard/definition_of_done.md's own Markdown table rows, the template's epigraphs parsed from templates/DoD.md's own `_"..."_ (\`standard/definition_of_done.md\` Section N)` blocks) rather than eyeballing either file, so the comparison is mechanical, not impressionistic. No required_fix.

This is the Mode B round-1 ruling recorded in the contract and design_notes: acceptable pre-commit, because the 9-entry payload is exercised at the feature commit's own CI once this uncommitted work is committed. Recorded honestly here rather than claimed as payload-exercised: the new template was NOT payload-exercised by this QA round's e2e run.
